resources.string: How far apart two cities are, and how long the trip takes.
How far is it to walk from Paris to Rome and back?
How long would it take to bike from Vienna to Budapest?
How long to drive from Berlin to Prague?
What\'s the distance between Madrid and Barcelona?

Madrid and Barcelona are about 504 km (313 miles) apart in a straight line. Roads and trails are usually longer than the straight line, by about a quarter, so expect roughly 630 km by land. This is an estimate from the cities\' coordinates, not a mapped route; the real route can differ.

It knows the 6,000 largest cities (GeoNames, CC BY 4.0) and works from their coordinates: the straight-line distance in km and miles; roughly how far by land (walking about 30% longer, cycling and driving about 25%); days to walk or cycle, hours to drive; there and back when you ask.\n\nEvery answer is an estimate, not a route: it can\'t know roads, borders, ferries or closures. A place that isn\'t one of those cities (a hotel, a beach, a small town) goes to the model, and so does a chat about health, an injury or danger. English only. Based on r4to\'s travel distance (BOAR R&D).
